request.description:
This dataset contains historical data for the following regions:

* ARA - Updated at 10AM CET every Wednesday. Data available from August 2012
* Canada - Updated at 10AM ET every Tuesday. Data available from April 2011
* Cushing - Updated Monday and Thursday at 10AM ET. Data available from May 2009
* Louisiana Gulf Coast - Updated at 10AM ET every Tuesday. Data available from May 2012
* Patoka - Updated at 10AM ET every Monday. Data available from June 2010
* Texas Gulf Coast - Updated at 10AM ET every Tuesday. Data available from July 2014
* West Texas - Updated at 10AM ET every Monday. Data available from October 2010

Refined Products and Renewables:
* ARA Gasoil & Jet Fuel - Updated at 10AM CET every Wednesday. Data available from August 2012
* ARA Gasoline & Naphtha - Updated at 10AM CET every Wednesday. Data available from September 2015
* ARA Ethanol & Methanol - Updated at 10AM CET every Wednesday. Data available from January 2019
* ARA Biodiesel & Renewable Diesel - Updated at 10AM CET every Wednesday. Data available from January 2022
* New York Harbor - Updated at 10AM ET every Tuesday. Data available from November 2013
* Gulf Coast Ethanol - Updated at 10AM ET every Tuesday. Data available from November 2014
* Chicago Ethanol - Updated at 12PM ET every Monday. Data available from August 2014

\* All updates subject to holiday delays – refer to the Holiday delay schedule for rescheduled publication dates
